messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] JAGS fits centered funnel just fine
parts:
This is just the centered version of Neal's funnel example.
It may exclude 0 because it's on the log scale, but JAGS gets
down to y = -6 and exp(-6) = .0025.

One of the x still has R-hat (as calculated by Coda) of 1.15,
so it's not perfect.

Does 8 schools (which one, by the way?) not work in JAGS/BUGS?
I found JAGS refreshingly easy to install on the Mac (there's
a package installer for JAGS and then rjags just finds it on
install, then R2jags is easy to install on top of that --- took
about 2 minutes total). But I forgot just how clunky those
R2WinBUGS and R2jags interfaces were.

- Bob
